full_judgment: 4. The defendant Nos.1 and 2 contested the suit by filing written statement. Their material case was that the plaintiffs predecessor Md. Bala Mia was the "middle interest holder" only of the suit land and as such alter the promulgation of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act the suit land vested in the Government and the Government has also leased out the suit land to different persons and that the plaintiffs have got no right, title and possession in the suit land.
